reviews.text: Highly highly recommend this salon!! They were so kind and sent updates. Did a fabulous job grooming my 2 mini dachshunds! And the boys were happy when I picked them up and wanted to go back inside which is always a good sign!

Salon Beysha is the best! I have a notoriously nervous cocker spaniel who looked absolutely beautiful and relaxed after her grooming here in a low stress atmosphere. She continued to be joyful after the appointment and looking great. I could not recommend their personalized care enough! 10/10

Salon Beysha did such a wonderful job on Huck. He hadn’t had a puppy cut in quite some time and was in desperate need. They sent photos throughout the entire process and even sent him home with a cute little bow. I can tell that they really care since they took such wonderful care of my pup!

So happy I found Salon Beysha! My Yorkie has been going to groomers for 10 years, and this salon is by far our favorite. The environment is clean and calm, and everyone was friendly and professional — not to mention the great service they provide. All the picture updates during her first appointment were so fun too. Thank you!
First time here and will not be my last.  Did an amazing job with my Toy Goldendoodle.  You can tell they take such good care of their furry clients. Thank you again! 💕 …

We came here as a recommendation from a friend and we are so glad we did. Beysha grooming is so caring and accommodating, they communicated with me throughout my senior dogs appointment via text. His haircut was exactly what I asked for and I could not be happier.

The best experience we’ve had in San Diego so far. They took great care of my Toy Poodle, who needs special attention. My puppy looked happy and calm after the service. I also really appreciated being kept informed throughout the process. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my puppy!

This is the BEST salon for pups!! They do an excellent cut and full service. They ask and remember what kind of cut you like for your dog. So thoughtful and sweet with your pups! AND my pup had a bit full and irregular glands - they said call and they’ll fit her in just for the glands if needed between grooming, at no cost! They are very reasonably priced, especially for such great grooming! My pup is always happy there and I’ve tried a ton of salons in San Diego- this one is the BEST!!!
Great service and prices!! highly recommend Manuela is the best always my dogs absolutely love her

Manuela & Tony are some of the sweetest, most caring people I’ve ever met, and you can truly see how much they love dogs. They treat every pup like their own, with so much patience and kindness. Highly recommend to anyone looking for groomers who really care. 🐾💕 …

If you are reading this, look no further! You have just stumbled upon the best groomers in the neighborhood. Manny and Tony are professional, trustworthy, kind, and talented! I went through many groomers with my 16 year old poodle mix and no one came close to Manny. The sheer PRECISION will knock your socks off. They will take great care of your babies, and will treat you like family. Support this local business, you wont regret it.

Manuela is the best around! She is an expert at her craft. Even more important, she is a dog lover. My dog had several bad experiences with prior groomers. She would shake as soon as she realized she was being groomed. That all changed with Manuela. Manuela took the time to get to know my dog and build her trust. After we started going to Salon BEYSHA, my pup loved being groomed. I have referred several people to her and they have all had the same experience. If I could give Salon BEYSHA 10 stars, I would!

I've taken my two dogs here so many times,  they always come back all wagging tails,  happy and the best part is that whenever they see Manuela they are sooo happy and excited!! then my husband and I know that they are receiving the best of the best 👌 thank you so much Manuela!! My little ones are in the best hands with you.

This was one of the best experiences I've ever had in my life. I wish all businesses had this level of thoughtfulness and care. I have a six month old puppy that I brought in and they took super amazing care of her.  The haircut was amazing and they gave us a handmade bow and a ribbon collar... They even got my pup a little toy referencing her namesake to play with and take home with her.

They felt like immediate family, even though I had never met either of them before. They also were super cute with posting pictures up on their TV and overall just being super welcoming. They also gave me a little bouquet of flowers, some treats and some doggy bags to go, which was just a cherry on top of the extremely amazing experience.

Also, I had to go to work for a few hours, so I let them know my timing and they were super kind about being able to hold her for a little while until I was able to make it back.

I have literally told dozens of people about them at this point. Even random people on the street. I have raved to them about this experience. Support local they are awesome. I live in Ocean Beach, but I still plan to drive over there because of how much I truly back this business.

We had a last minute cancellation of our appt at a not so good location right off the main drag in pb, and these kind folks helped us with our little dog. They made sure our dog was comfortable and made sure we were comfortable with them as well. They're super welcoming and did the Lord's work on our little long haired weenie dog 😍 …

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I took my Yorkie puppy to Salon BEYSHA for her very first haircut, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! Manny and Tony were so thorough and took the time to explain how they carefully introduce each grooming tool to puppies. They made sure the whole process was positive and stress-free, using lots of treats and patience to help my pup feel comfortable.

Manny and Tony went above and beyond! They gave my baby a new toy, took the cutest photos, and sent me text updates throughout the appointment so I could see how she was doing. The level of care and attention here is unmatched. I left with a happy, beautifully groomed puppy and complete peace of mind. And look who made the cover of their new business cards! Highly recommend Salon BEYSHA  to any pet owner who wants their furry friend! 💕🐶

I’m so grateful they moved into our neighborhood! Our dog FIBBS loves this place. You’d think I was taking him to the dog park — but he’s just going to the groomer! He gets so excited every time we walk in. They do a fantastic job with his haircuts. Don’t look anywhere else — bring your dog here for grooming!
My pup Milo did great his first appointment, I’m sure because of the great service and care provided. We will definitely be regular customers :)

We brought our Pomeranian for the first time, and had the best experience! Manny and Tony took the time to get to know our dog first, getting him settled in and comfortable, before giving him the spa treatment. They were extra attentive with his dry, itchy skin and matted fur. We even got updates throughout his appointment. He came out looking so well groomed! People stopped to admire and pet him on our walk home. We are excited to have such a knowledgeable, expert groomer in the PB neighborhood, and look forward to bringing in our pup regularly. Thank you, Salon BEYSHA!!
Phenomenal business with the most kind hearted owners. They did an amazing job with our pip who doesn’t do great with strangers.  Highly recommended.

I can’t say enough good things about Salon Beysha! Manny and Tony were so incredible warm and welcoming to both me and my dog. Making an appointment was extremely easy, as Manny was really responsive and detailed over text. When we arrived for our appt, they made to sure ask about all of my dog’s special needs, medical issues, etc. and reassured me that they go at whatever pace he’s comfortable with. They even sent me updates during the appointment and cute photos afterwards. They also sent us home with some treats and flowers, which was just the sweetest. They also did an amazing job with my dog’s haircut and did exactly what I asked! My dog and I will definitely be returning! Thank you Manny and Tony!

I am so happy I found this place and these amazing people that took care of my baby Basil.  The owners are incredibly sweet and patient, especially with my dog, who’s a little shy and anxious. The salon has the cutest vibe, and feels so welcoming—They made it so personable and inviting with a welcome sign for our first time!

They took their time, made sure everything was perfect, and even added a little bow that melted my heart. I’ve tried a few other groomers in the area, but nothing compares to the care and quality at Salon Beysha.  Highly recommend, if you’re looking for quality and great care of your fur babies. 🐾🐾🐾🐕💚

They are BACK!!! What can I say other than these are the BEST dog groomers I have ever had the fortune to meet! Former owners of San Doggy Mobile Grooming are back in business here in Pacific Beach/Birdrock San Diego!!! They just opened …
Manuela always does an amazing job. She is so kind and takes her time with them which makes all the difference for my nervous pups.
